fields.row: No strength optimism / sheet at guaranteed minimum
fields.effect: No strength optimism is true only relative to the inherited 283-MPa starting value. The current guide's S-200F value does not support that point without an uplift. The 345-MPa sheet number is tensile; equality in compression is an additional transfer assumption.
fields.product_form: The S-200F datasheet offers SR-200 sheet and PS-200 foil as additional options below 6.3 mm; it does not establish an exclusive mandatory substitution. SR-200 below 0.059 inch is available only at smaller sheet dimensions. The datasheet's parenthetic 0.059 inch = 0.5 mm is internally inconsistent (0.059 inch = 1.4986 mm).
fields.disposition: Confirms and sharpens the owner's existing Be-strength/sheet-size NFI; does not stop the estimate.
fields.proposed_fix: Use a matched product/lot/thickness compression value; keep the tensile-to-compressive transfer explicit. MAINLINE-020 is the named grounding card.
